## [I was extremely disappointed in the…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a14a2729fd0201b097dd599)
I was extremely disappointed in the quality of the storage jars I purchased. They were not inexpensive so I certainly did not expect to find that what I thought were brass lids, were poorly painted gold that was worn away in spots. One lid had a hole in the paint. In addition, the gaskets used to keep the jars air tight, were unevenly exposed once the lids were placed on the jars. Even though, I opted to keep the products (re packaging them would have been a big hassle), replacing the defective lids and gaskets would be expected.

May 13, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 26, 2026

Hi Malinda,

Thank you for sharing your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience regarding the quality of the storage jars that you ordered. We are here to help! Please reach out to our Customer Support team, and we will promptly assist you with a resolution.

Lulu and Georgia
